name: google-secops
description: Essential Security Operations skills for Triage, Investigation, and Hunting.

interface.shortDescription: Essential Security Operations skills for Triage, Investigation, and Hunting

secops.http_headers_helper: TOKEN=$(gcloud auth application-default print-access-token 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo 'google-secops: no ADC token; run: gcloud auth application-default login' >&2; exit 1; fi; PROJECT="${PROJECT_ID:-$(gcloud config get-value project 2>/dev/null)}"; if [ -z "$PROJECT" ]; then echo 'google-secops: no quota project; set PROJECT_ID or run: gcloud config set project PROJECT_ID' >&2; exit 1; fi; printf '{"Authorization": "Bearer %s", "x-goog-user-project": "%s"}' "$TOKEN" "$PROJECT"
